name: building-blocks-shapes
title: Shapes
description: Basic Tailwind circle and pill atoms for icons, avatars, tags, and compact controls.
useWhen: Basic Tailwind circle and pill atoms for icons, avatars, tags, and compact controls.
avoidWhen: Avoid shapes when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Shapes uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
